statement: The predicted conservation errors exhibit O(tau^2*k) behavior during the paper's Qwen-3-style and ViT training on WikiText-103, PTB, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet-1K.
required_scope: Three learning rates and ten independent seeds per configuration, exact paper architectures, optimizers, schedules, datasets, and block metric.
acceptance: Reproduce the named training trajectories with raw data and confidence intervals, or produce an assumption-matched contradiction of that exact empirical statement.
